polityNote: Republic of Turkey: the 67 provinces (il) from the re-creation of Kırşehir (Law 7001, in force 1957-07-01) to the day before TUR.json (Natural Earth, from Law 3392 of 1987-07-04) begins. Atoms: geoBoundaries TUR ADM2 (973 districts, OpenStreetMap, ODbL, 2021); each province = today's districts of it plus the whole districts that later went to provinces created 1989–1999. Provinces whose later lines were redrawn through villages (Giresun/Gümüşhane, Samsun/Ordu, Tunceli/Bingöl, Muğla/Aydın) are withheld; Ankara and Çankırı start in 1980. 1923–1957 (63–67 provinces; the 1926, 1929, 1933 abolitions and 1936–1954 re-creations) is not drawn here.
